steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Evaluation = analysis + judgement. You must say HOW effective something was AND WHY. | Key Fact: Criteria for evaluation: did the choice serve the production's intention? Did it communicate meaning clearly? Did it engage the audience? | Key Fact: Support every judgement with SPECIFIC evidence from the production — never make unsupported claims. | Key Fact: Performance evaluation: vocal skills, physical skills, characterisation, interaction. Design evaluation: set, costume, lighting, sound, props.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: What criteria would you use to evaluate whether a performer's choices were effective? | How would you evaluate a lighting design's contribution to a production? Give specific examples. | Explain the difference between analysis and evaluation. Why does evaluation require judgement?
